results.title: Paraguay 2026 World Cup Preview: Squad, Schedule, Odds & Best Bets
highlights:
Paraguay returns to the FIFA World Cup after a 16-year absence, relying on a robust and experienced defence under manager Gustavo Alfaro. Their qualification was built on low-scoring, disciplined performances, making them tough opponents. While strong at the back and equipped with Premier League talent in Diego Gomez and exciting attackers like Julio Enciso, expectations of a lengthy run are low. Still, Paraguay could surprise in Group D against USA, Turkey, and Australia, with value in betting on low-scoring games rather than an outright win.
[...]
Paraguay are back at the World Cup after a 16-year absence. Known for their defensive prowess, that solidity is likely to be their calling card at the tournament.
[...]
La Albirroja have the experienced Gustavo Alfaro in charge and with strong players in key positions, Paraguay will be confident of defying expectations.
[...]
Paraguay’s qualification was built on defensive resilience. Finishing 6th in South America, they only scored 14 goals but were breached just 10 times, equal with table topping Argentina.
[...]
La Albirroja specialised in grinding out low-scoring results, frustrating opponents and squeezing the life out of matches.
[...]
Alfaro has restored Paraguay's defensive values, turning them into an organised and pragmatic team. He is likely to continue with employing low blocks and attempting to hit the opposition on counter attacks.
[...]
Brighton & Hove Albion's Diego Gomez adds Premier League experience to the midfield. Julio Enciso is an excitement machine and former Newcastle winger Miguel Almiron is the top scorer in the squad with nine goals.
